sentences.en: Sami is the most easy-going person to talk to.
sentences.zh: 萨米是最容易相处的人。

sentences.en: He's an easy-going bloke – always has both feet on the ground.
sentences.zh: 他是个随和的人——总是脚踏实地。

sentences.en: I plan on having easy-going day at home during the holiday.
sentences.zh: 我打算在假期里过一个轻松随意的日子在家休息。

senses.zh: 脾气随和的；不慌不忙的
